blocks.prompt: 2. Use Trapezoidal Rule to approximate the value of the definite integral \(\int_{0}^{1} e^{x}\,dx\) taking \(n = 7\).
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke yeh kis qisam ka sawal hai: definite integral ki value Trapezium Rule se approximately nikalni hai, seedha integration nahi karna.
Diya kya hai? Function \(f(x) = e^{x}\), interval \([0, 1]\), aur \(n = 7\) diya hai, to \(h = \frac{b-a}{n}\) nikalega.
Find kya karna hai? Integral ki approximate value, chaar decimal places tak.
Rule kaunsa aur kyun? Trapezium Rule, kyunke sawal yahi maangta hai: area ko barabar chaurai ki pattiyon (trapeziums) mein baant kar jama karna.
Plan: h ya n, phir points ki list, phir har point par function ki value, phir beech wali values ka jama, aur aakhir mein formula aur tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = e^{x}\), \(a = 0\), \(b = 1\), \(n = 7\).
Maloom karna: \(\int_{0}^{1} e^{x}\,dx\) ki approximate value.
Tareeqa: sawal khud Trapezium Rule maang raha hai, is liye wohi lagayenge. Yahan n diya hua hai, is liye pehle h nikalenge. Phir points aur un par function ki values (chaar decimal tak) nikal kar formula \(\frac{h}{2}[\text{pehli} + 2(\text{beech wali}) + \text{aakhri}]\) mein rakhenge.

Continuity
Exponential function \(e^{x}\) har real number par continuous hai, is liye \([0, 1]\) par bhi continuous hai.
Kyun: Trapezium Rule continuous function ke liye bana hai; agar graph beech mein toot jaye to trapeziums us hisse ko sahi nahi dhaanp sakte.

Step size aur points
\[h = \dfrac{b-a}{n} = \dfrac{1-0}{7} = \dfrac{1}{7}\]
Points \(x_{i} = a + ih\): \(0, \tfrac{1}{7}, \tfrac{2}{7}, \tfrac{3}{7}, \tfrac{4}{7}, \tfrac{5}{7}, \tfrac{6}{7}, 1\)
Kyun: interval ko 7 barabar hisson mein baanta, to har hisse ki chaurai \(h\) hai. 7 subintervals ke 8 points bante hain: pehla point \(a\) aur aakhri \(b\), baqi beech wale.

Function values (4 decimal places)
\[f(0) = e^{0} = 1.0000\]
\[f(\tfrac{1}{7}) = e^{\tfrac{1}{7}} = 1.1536\]
\[f(\tfrac{2}{7}) = e^{\tfrac{2}{7}} = 1.3307\]
\[f(\tfrac{3}{7}) = e^{\tfrac{3}{7}} = 1.5351\]
\[f(\tfrac{4}{7}) = e^{\tfrac{4}{7}} = 1.7708\]
\[f(\tfrac{5}{7}) = e^{\tfrac{5}{7}} = 2.0427\]
\[f(\tfrac{6}{7}) = e^{\tfrac{6}{7}} = 2.3564\]
\[f(1) = e^{1} = 2.7183\]
Kyun: har point ko function mein rakha. \(h = \frac{1}{7}\) ko fraction hi rakhein; \(\frac{1}{7} = 0.142857\ldots\) ko pehle hi round kar diya to points thore khisak jayenge aur jawab ka chautha decimal kharab ho sakta hai. Calculator mein \(e^{1/7}\), \(e^{2/7}\) waghaira seedhe likhein.
Dhyan dein: \(e^{x}\) ki har value 1 se bari hai aur barhti ja rahi hai; agar koi value pichli se kam aaye to samajh lein typing ki ghalti hai.
Neeche jawab ke saath di gayi table mein yahi values un ke weights (1 ya 2) ke saath hain.

Beech wali values jama karein
\[S = f(x_{1}) + \dots + f(x_{6})\]
\[= 1.1536 + 1.3307 + 1.5351\]
\[+ 1.7708 + 2.0427 + 2.3564\]
\[= 10.1893\]
Kyun: yeh 6 beech wali values har ek do saath wale trapeziums ki saanjhi deewar hain, is liye formula mein in ka jama do dafa (double) aayega. Pehle in ka jama alag nikal lena hisaab ko saaf aur check karne ke qabil banata hai.

Trapezium Rule apply karein
\[\int_{0}^{1} e^{x}\,dx\]
\[\approx \dfrac{h}{2}\big[f(x_{0}) + 2S + f(x_{7})\big]\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{14}\big[1.0000 + 2(10.1893)\]
\[+ 2.7183\big]\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{14}(24.0969)\]
\[= 1.721207 \approx 1.7212\]
Kyun: \(\frac{h}{2} = \frac{1}{14}\). Kinaron wali do values ek ek dafa aayin aur beech wali values ka jama do dafa; phir poore bracket ko \(\frac{h}{2}\) se zarb diya. Round sirf aakhri jawab ko kiya, beech mein nahi, taake ghalti jama na ho.

Tasdeeq:
\[\int_{0}^{1} e^{x}\,dx = e - 1 \approx 1.7183\]
Kyun: \(e^{x}\) ka antiderivative khud \(e^{x}\) hai, is liye exact value \(e^{1} - e^{0} = e - 1\) hai. Hamara jawab 1.7212 is se thora sa zyada hai, aur yahi hona chahiye tha: \(e^{x}\) upar ki taraf mudta (concave up) hai, is liye har trapezium ki seedhi chhat curve ke upar rehti hai aur thora extra area gin leti hai. Farq sirf 0.003 hai.
